digest.component_or_area: code-review gate criteria routing and threshold calibration
propositions: correctness and edge-cases dimensions lack explicit routing entries and resolve through the 0.95 default instead of being measured at 0.54
measured friction for correctness (4.04% of changes) and edge-cases (1.74% of changes) both stay within the 8.0% operator-accepted budget when blocked at 0.54
the replay_code_v4_would_block.py script hard-codes a blocking set that drifts from actual routed postures when new criteria are added
the canonical criterion vocabulary is derived from routing_index(), so adding correctness and edge-cases entries widens the effective criteria set
concurrency remains advisory (0.95 threshold, blocking_enabled false) due to insufficient sample size (n=1 below MIN_N=25 power floor)
